comments.body_html:
Hello Rukira,

I have a few changes to the mod lingering here

Those are mainly QOL changes for the maintainer, like centralizing the version number and using a powershell script to generate the zip file

and last but not least using a python script to upload to my gitlab (you could adapt it to upload to github I’m sure).

Anyways, feel free to git pull all my changes in your new github repository!

If you want help to pull the changes or to understand some parts don’t hesitate to reach out to me…

Thanks for taking the maintenance of this great mod!

Flir
